audit.why: Spike timings check out against the kit: Purge (W) is 12/9/6/3/0s so it is near-permanent by W max, Fear Beyond Death lands at 6 on a 100/85/70s cooldown, and Locke's own spikes are 6 (Purgatory) and Lich Bane. spikes[] already has 4 entries with sane 'when' values.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; spike prose corrected for mechanics only (see point 4).

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors. (a) spikes[1], whys[6] and 'late' describe Fear Beyond Death as a flip/suppress that yanks you back on cast — Riot's text says the spear impales the first champion hit, and only the execute recast (once they are under the threshold) drags and suppresses. (b) spikes[2] credits Urgot's passive with shielding him; Echoing Flames is damage-only — the shield is on Disdain (E). (c) wants.foe[2] calls R a flip; the flip is Disdain (E).
audit.why: Riot's own descriptions in the kit file are authority. Getting the R wrong changes the advice: the initial spear is a 2500-range projectile you can dodge or body-block, so 'you cannot escape it' is false and 'stay above his threshold' is the actual rule.
audit.corrected: R = long-range impale + slow; the recast is the suppress-execute and only exists under the threshold. Shield belongs to Disdain (E), which is also the flip.

audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and is his only engage; the page already names it as the tracked cooldown. Fear Beyond Death at 70s late is now stated in the 'late' rewrite.
audit.corrected: Added the 70-second R window to breakdown-adjacent prose.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death (R) is your worst nightmare as an execute champ: he also executes below a threshold, but his flip is a hard suppress that yanks you back, so racing him to the kill line usually means you die to his R first.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death (R) is your worst nightmare as an execute champ: the spear impales and slows from 2500 range, and once you drop under his threshold the recast suppresses and drags you in, so never race him to the kill line.

edits.before: After first item his tankiness and Purge shred outstat your single burst; you chunk him, he presses W and W-Q's you back to even while his passive shields keep him healthy.
edits.after: After first item his tankiness and Purge shred outstat your single burst; you chunk him, he presses W and W-Q's you back to even while Disdain's shield eats the rest of your combo.

edits.before: Late Urgot is a tanky executioner who beats your identity outright. His R suppresses through your E blink and his Disdain knockback can flip you into his kill zone. Anti-heal and armor help you survive, but you cannot solo him; play around teammates who can body-block Disdain and burn his R, then clean up only when his execute is on cooldown.
edits.after: Late Urgot is a tanky executioner who beats your identity outright. His R is a 2500-range projectile — break line of sight or let a teammate body-block it, because once it impales you the recast suppresses and no blink saves you. Armor helps you survive, but you cannot solo him; clean up only while his 70-second ultimate is down.
